releases.name: Parry Survivor
releases.summary: Control an anime heroine in the Kun-Domain! Master Sekiro-style parries to deflect endless waves of Kuns, unleash cinematic executions, and upgrade your damage and weapons in this fast-paced action game.

releases.name: Blood Lily: Killers Can't Sink a Yuri Ship
releases.summary:
Having a crush on your bestie is hard enough without serial killers in the way! 

Lily's vacay plan to romance her crush Sally goes wrong when killers keep cropping up and ruining the mood. And that means war.

A B-horror mystery comedy adventure game.

releases.name: Wait, Cards I Memorized?
releases.summary: A memory training game inspired by the Memory Palace technique. Memorize 13 cards using 13 hooks on your face and body. Each card links to an image that shares its suit's first letter. Memorize. Recall. Match. More modes are planned, including voice control, AVG, and shooter gameplay.

releases.name: Don't Stop Cutting The Trees!
releases.summary: X Battle Field is the logic game. Main idea is the occupation of fields. Basically it close to tic-tac-toe, but advanced one. Rules of the game are very simple.Yellow fields are the entrances.Start from it.You can move only on left, right, top or bottom of your fields.If you close some space with empty fields and there is no opponent's fields than this space became yours.To win you should fill more fields than opponent. Starting new game try to find your own strategy how to get more space. Improve your logic skills with X Battle Field. 40 different levels are waiting for you. Join your friends for head-to-head battle. Check your tactics with partners. Spend your free time with fun.Good luck!

releases.name: After Dark Jigsaw
releases.summary: As a pride member of the solar system Alpha Centauri, you just join the Legion to fight in the galaxy !Epsilon Eridani is in danger, as the nearest solar system you are in charge of defending it. An unknown enemies forces has make the first strike and drew first blood. Those aliens are ferocious and kills mercilessly, we do not know what they wan't, but it's not the time to talk but the time to fight ! You join the academy of the Legion group for this reason exactly, to protect the lives of billions of innocent people and to fight evil all across the universe.Collect star medals credits the buy new ships in the space fleet, you start with your slow but trusty spaceship. It will do for now, but you know that you can find better ship with higher speed and better weapon. Unlock 5 new spacecrafts and gain rank in the academy and become a Legion hero who saves the day ! Fight hordes of thoses stranges enemies and discover what they want or exterminate them all !!Play this topdown galactic arcade game, use your finger on the screen to control your spaceship, autofire is on so you just have avoid danger to stay alive as long as you can.Avoid collision with meteor or satellite and at the same time destroy the enemy's spaceships.Collect star credit to unlock new spaceship for you to control, start with Ceres, but unlock 5 other spaceships, Pluto, Haum Ea, Makem Ake, Eris and The Sun !Go as far as you can in the galaxy and keep your score in recorded in Gamecenter to know if you’re the best in the world. You can challenge your friends to know who’s best.

releases.name: RPG System
releases.summary: Create and play tabletop RPG adventures with your friends in immersive 2D and 3D environments. Build characters, explore fantasy worlds, roll dice, manage tactical turn-based battles, and bring your own stories to life in an online cooperative virtual tabletop.

releases.name: Jumpy vs. Chompy
releases.summary: Jump, stomp, dodge, and escape as Chompy closes in. Race through branching platforming stages solo or with a friend in local split-screen, grab power-ups, and chase faster clear times.

releases.name: ClayMonsters
releases.summary: Introducing Furious Football!A casual take on the popular sport. Furious Football utilizes physics based gameplay in a simple and fun arcade style game. Pass the ball with precision and timing to drive your team down the field to glory. Afterwards, compare your own high scores to your friends and other players on Gamecenter.

releases.name: KasMind
releases.summary: The most lawless taunt-em-up has arrived! Smack them with a paper fan, then mock them while they're down, mock them from a distance, mock them out of pure spite — spam taunts and victory is yours. "So... how does it feel?"

releases.name: Station 5:21
releases.summary: Wake up inside a frozen mid-day dream. Explore desolate squares, long shadows, and abstract architecture inspired by Giorgio de Chirico. Unravel the mysteries of distorted 1970s television broadcasts in a melancholic 2.5D puzzle platformer.

releases.name: Rehaunted
releases.summary: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.

releases.name: MAINLINE
releases.summary: You are caffeine. A high-velocity roguelite FPS through a human bloodstream. Your survival timer only refills by killing — stop and you're metabolized. Every kill makes you faster. Every run rolls new weapons and upgrades. Reach the brain before he falls asleep.

releases.name: Emo Lisa
releases.summary: BATTLE your friends to see who really knows Rap. Are you into the new age mainstream that rocks out to Nicki Minaj, 2 Chainz and Asap Rocky? Or are you an old head that bangs Run DMC, Rakim or A Tribe Called Quest? Either way, we got you! YOU NEED THIS RAP TRIVIA APP NOW!New Rap/Hip Hop fans will have a blast as they DISCOVER a classic catalog of artists and songs from both the Old School and the New School for the first time. Meanwhile, enduring fans reconnect with what made them fall in love with Rap in the first place. Ready to Battle? Get started with this FREE Rap trivia app TODAY! Features:Turn Based GameHours of funVarious Question TypesFacebook IntegrationDiss message barLeader boardsAchievementsPremium Features:Custom AvatarsAd-FreeMic packages for extended play

releases.name: Are You Chicken?
releases.summary: Show your courage to earn your place in this world! A quick and fun egg-rolling game you can enjoy anytime.

releases.name: Grim Wanderings Reborn
releases.summary: A grim turn-based tactical RPG. Hire a squad, travel through the cursed lands through battles and unusual encounters, upgrade your fighters and equip your hero with relics. Hundreds of units, events, and artifacts. Each passage will be unique.
